description: Anonymous public Amazon.com catalog XHR scope. Search/detail documents and observed UI XHRs do not satisfy the required API operations. See references/retail-amazon-contracts.json and verification/retail-amazon-live-2026-10-05.json.

capabilities.title: Search validated main product cards with displayed price and thumbnail through anonymous XHR
capabilities.note: Direct POST /s/query works for page 1 without cookies or qid/xpid. Result scope is validated main cards; some responses report additional ASINs and are marked partial.

capabilities.title: Read full product detail by ASIN from a validated anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: A related-product vendor JSON GET was observed once, but its ASIN did not match the current detail page. Direct replay returned 415 without the browser's exact Accept; source-backed anonymous HTTP attempts returned 406, 503 or 404.

capabilities.title: List or filter product categories through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: No category data XHR was observed in the bounded anonymous journey.

capabilities.title: Page through validated main search cards using the anonymous XHR page parameter
capabilities.note: Pages 1, 2 and 3 yielded distinct verified main cards without cookies. Full catalog coverage and last-page termination remain separate gaps.

capabilities.title: Detect the last accessible search page and report full result coverage
capabilities.blocker: The streaming metadata's total/ASIN counts do not prove all products or last-page access; termination has not been replayed.

capabilities.title: Distinguish current/list price, coupon, currency and stock from product data
capabilities.blocker: Search-card displayed current price and explicit KRW amount are verified. Full product offer/list price, coupon, checkout price and stock semantics are not replayed.

capabilities.title: Read product description, features and specifications through a validated anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: A public product document contained description markup, but no independently replayed XHR for full description or specifications was found.

capabilities.title: Read all product image URLs, sizes and variants through a validated anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: Search-card thumbnail URLs are verified. Full gallery images, sizes and variants remain unverified because the anonymous product/v2 XHR did not return a product entity.

capabilities.title: Read selectable variations and child ASIN mappings through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: A twisterDimensionSlotsDefault XHR was observed once, but its exact query values and result schema were not captured or independently replayed.

capabilities.title: Read individual full review bodies, rating and date through anonymous XHR
capabilities.blocker: An anonymous browser visit to a product-reviews page showed Sign in, with zero review-body nodes and no review-data XHR. Rating counts are not full review text.

capabilities.title: Page through complete review bodies with a verified continuation contract
capabilities.blocker: No anonymous review-body page or review pagination XHR was observed; the visited review page displayed Sign in.

capabilities.title: Read homepage card fragments from anonymous XHR when useful
capabilities.blocker: The streaming XHR replayed but its 10 encrypted inputs came from the browser page; their engine-free acquisition is unverified, and sampled cards contained no product paths or price nodes.

capabilities.title: Acquire a personal Amazon login
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested anonymous public reads without login.

capabilities.title: Read or edit an Amazon account profile
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Personal account/profile operations are outside this anonymous public-read scope.

capabilities.title: Change a cart or address
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Cart and address writes are outside the requested read-only scope.

capabilities.title: Place an order or send a message
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Ordering and messaging are outside the requested read-only scope.

capabilities.title: Use the credentialed Associates Creators API
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Creators API requires Associates eligibility and API credentials; this request is limited to anonymous public XHR.
